name: alert-notification-ms
description: Alert dispatch microservice — BullMQ + MySQL + Vonage + Nodemailer

scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:cron"
scripts.kill:port: fuser -k ${PORT:-3000}/tcp && echo 'Port freed' || echo 'Nothing on port'
scripts.kill:all: pkill -f 'node server-' && echo 'All server processes killed' || echo 'Nothing to kill'
